content: {"phoneNote": "Strong, confident layout with an authentic workshop photo right at the top and a very clear typographic hierarchy.", "desktopNote": "The hero section and services list are clean and industrial, though the 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' section feels sparse with just two words in the right column.", "phone": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 4, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 5, "distinctiveness": 4}, "desktop": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 4, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 5, "distinctiveness": 4}, "fixes": ["In the 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' section on desktop, flesh out the right column (e.g., list key towns or add a simple map) so 'Savinjska regija' doesn't float in an empty space.", "Turn the 'Pokličite nas' link in the dark CTA banner into a high-contrast button to make the primary action stand out more.", "Tighten the vertical padding slightly around the 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' section on both viewports to integrate it better with the surrounding blocks."], "blockers": []}
